signals.name: Product comparison
signals.definition: The subject places two or more specific products, plans, or vendors side by side, or repeatedly views the same competing set within a session window. Qualifying condition: at least two distinct product or plan identifiers appear in one comparison context, or a dedicated comparison surface is opened.
signals.question_answered: Has the buyer moved from browsing a category to narrowing a shortlist, and which alternatives are still live?

capability_ladder.how: Instrument comparison_started / comparison_updated / comparison_completed on your own comparison tool or plan table
capability_ladder.gives: First-party, full fidelity, no third party involved

capability_ladder.how: Infer from consecutive product-detail views of two or more items in the same category inside one session
capability_ladder.gives: Lower precision, but needs no new instrumentation

capability_ladder.how: Category-level comparison intent from a review-platform partner programme
requires: paid vendor listing in that category
capability_ladder.gives: Account-level only, and only if your category is listed

access_conditions: Rung 3 is obtainable only by becoming a listed vendor; it cannot be bought as raw data

freshness.note: A comparison is meaningful while the shortlist is open; it decays as the buyer either commits or lapses.

false_positives: Existing customer checking whether to upgrade rather than buy

signals.name: Inferred health status or clinical journey stage
signals.definition: Deriving a person's health condition, treatment stage, diagnosis, fertility status, or clinical trajectory from behaviour - browsing, purchases, content consumption, or device signals - rather than from information they knowingly provided for that purpose.
signals.question_answered: None that this tool will help you answer. This entry exists so the class can be named and excluded, not detected.
signals.terms_note: Regulated as consumer health data in several US states regardless of the source of the underlying behaviour.
signals.prohibition_basis: Inferred health status is regulated consumer health data under Washington's My Health My Data Act (opt-in consent, separate authorization to sell, private right of action, extraterritorial reach) and comparable Nevada and Connecticut provisions; Maryland's Online Data Privacy Act restricts the sale of sensitive data regardless of consent. Under GDPR Art. 9 it is special-category data requiring an Art. 9(2) condition, which behavioural inference does not supply. The FTC's actions against GoodRx, Premom and Flo Health charged exactly the practice of building audience segments from inferred health signals. Beyond the legal exposure, the failure mode is not theoretical: shared-device and household-linked retargeting of a clinical journey causes documented, serious harm to real people.

freshness.note: Not applicable - this class is excluded, not scored.

false_positives: Research on behalf of a family member, patient, or client
A shared device used by several members of a household
